answer: Each agent stakes a cedar post — 500 POA locked to one device key — before answering. Step 1: register the hardware-bound key and lock 500 POA. Step 2: pass a weekly attestation in a 10-minute window; miss it and slash 250 POA. Step 3: duplicate keys share one slashing pool, so a second answer from the same cedar post burns the bond. A willow bends but keeps one trunk; a terrace ties each plot to one owner. To run 1000 fakes, the attacker locks 500000 POA in 1000 cedar posts — any duplicate key loses its post. A sybil farm is saplings: easy to plant, impossible to make each a cedar.
